title: महामृत्युंजय मंत्र
subtitle: Maha Mrityunjaya Mantra
sanskrit:
ॐ त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनम्।
उर्वारुकमिव बन्धनान्मृत्योर्मुक्षीय माऽमृतात्॥
translation: We meditate on the Three-eyed Lord who nourishes and sustains all beings. May He liberate us from the cycle of death into immortality.

title: शिव ताण्डव स्तोत्रम्
subtitle: Shiva Tandava Stotram
sanskrit:
जटाटवीगलज्जलप्रवाहपावितस्थले
गलेऽवलम्ब्य लम्बितां भुजङ्गतुङ्गमालिकाम्।
डमड्डमड्डमड्डमन्निनादवड्डमर्वयं
चकार चण्डताण्डवं तनोतु नः शिवः शिवम्॥
translation: With His neck sanctified by the celestial waters trickling through His matted hair, wearing a lofty serpent necklace, and moving to the resonant rhythm of the damru, may Lord Shiva bring auspiciousness to all.

title: श्री रुद्राष्टकम्
subtitle: Shri Rudrashtakam
sanskrit:
नमामीशमीशान निर्वाणरूपं
विभुं व्यापकं ब्रह्मवेदस्वरूपम्।
निजं निर्गुणं निर्विकल्पं निरीहं
चिदाकाशमाकाशवासं भजेऽहम्॥
translation: I bow to the Supreme Lord, the master of all directions, the embodiment of liberation, omnipresent, all-pervading, and the very essence of the Vedas.
